hooks.command: bash -c "if git diff --cached --diff-filter=d -U0 | grep -qEi 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,}|sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sk_test_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|whsec_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|sbp_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|service_role_key.*=.*eyJ|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY=eyJ'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Secret/credential detected in staged changes. Unstage the file and remove the secret before committing.' && exit 1; fi && if git diff --cached --name-only | grep -qE '^\.env$|^\.env\.local$|^\.env\.production$|^\.env\.development$'; then echo 'BLOCKED: .env file detected in staged changes. Never commit .env files.' && exit 1; fi && echo 'Secrets scan passed.'"
echo 'BLOCKED: Never use git add . or git add -A. Stage specific files by name to avoid accidentally committing secrets.' && exit 1
echo 'BLOCKED: Never use git add -A. Stage specific files by name to avoid accidentally committing secrets.' && exit 1
